description: This file is a PHP script used for setup and testing purposes in the OrangeHRM project. It handles environment checks, file system operations (creating symlinks, changing permissions), service registration (cache, Doctrine ORM), and initiates a database backup. It is part of the testing tools in the project, specifically for functional testing.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: Autoloads PHP classes following PSR-4 standards, used here to load project classes dynamically.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class that provides environment constants and configuration paths.

classes.name: Filesystem
classes.description: Handles filesystem operations such as symlink creation and permission modification.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: Manages dependency injection and service registration.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: Handles ORM entity management for database operations.

classes.name: DatabaseBackupService
classes.description: Provides database backup and savepoint creation functionalities.

methods.name: createInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Creates an initial database savepoint for testing/reset purposes.
